label: BROWSERFIX-2
title: BROWSERFIX-2 — independently reviewed new-test revision and browser repair
description: Child of EVAL-66, on original base eeb0718643e35a3ecb58f1b44711df928225950d and identical delivery contract. Historic Red and all 109 baseline tests remain immutable. PHASE 1 TESTS ONLY: create tests/test_browser_feedback_flow.py as a corrected revision of the NEW Node VM regression. Preserve coverage for real app.js execution, submit POST /feedback, completion API request, summary after creation/completion and captured polling after external change. Keep the five test method names from the prior regression. Execute the real app/static/app.js in a Node vm with native Window.status string coercion, not replacement application logic. DOM textContent setters must coerce values to String; summary counts must obey total=open+completed (after one completed item and one externally added open item: total=2, open=1, completed=1). Record explicit filename and source hash from the path and bytes actually loaded; do not depend on a nonexistent vm.Script.filename property. Use bounded subprocess timeout and deterministic promise flushing. No skipped tests, swallowed exceptions, weakened assertions or regex-only behavioral proof. The controller captures fresh Red on the ORIGINAL base. A different profile must independently approve its exact manifest before PHASE 2 is allowed. Then edit only app/static/app.js to fix the Window.status collision while preserving every frozen test and the initial loadSummary call. Do not replay Red or edit tests in implementation. Run exactly: cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -q 2>&1. No GitHub, network, Docker, credentials or other projects. A Node harness is not real-browser acceptance.
review_instruction: Review immutable /delivery only. Require controller Red/Green, independent approval of the exact new-test manifest, and byte-identical baseline tests. Require real app.js execution, faithful Window.status/textContent semantics and behavioral coverage of submission, completion, summary and polling. Reject replacement application logic, ignored exceptions, skips, inconsistent counts or weakened coverage. Run the controlled complete suite. Do not edit tests or recreate Red. Real-browser acceptance is a separate mandatory gate. Finish with Decision: APPROVE or Decision: REQUEST_CHANGES;Reason: <specific finding>.
